description: This file defines the SupervisorEvaluationAPI class, a PHP REST API endpoint for handling supervisor evaluations within a performance review module of an HR management system. It includes methods for fetching, updating, and managing review-related data, with detailed OpenAPI annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: SupervisorEvaluationAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class providing CRUD operations and additional methods for managing supervisor evaluations related to performance reviews within the system.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves supervisor evaluation data, applying sorting and pagination, and returns review ratings along with meta-information such as allowed actions and comments.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getAll endpoint, primarily validating the reviewId parameter and sorting options.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Determines and normalizes the list of permissible actions based on the review state and user permissions.

methods.name: getReviewerRatings
methods.description: Fetches reviewer ratings for a specific review and reviewer group.

methods.name: getReviewerRatingCount
methods.description: Counts the number of reviewer ratings for a specific review and reviewer group.

methods.name: getReviewIdParamRule
methods.description: Defines validation rule for reviewId parameter.

methods.name: getKpisForReview
methods.description: Retrieves KPI summaries associated with a review.

methods.name: getReviewerForReviewRating
methods.description: Fetches reviewer details for a specific review.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Method placeholder for creating a new resource; not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for create operation; not implemented.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Method placeholder for deleting a resource; not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for delete operation; not implemented.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Method placeholder for fetching a single resource; not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for fetching a single resource; not implemented.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates supervisor review ratings and comments within a transaction, checking permissions and updating review status.

methods.name: setReviewRatingsParams
methods.description: Saves or updates review ratings for a given review.

methods.name: getPerformanceReviewStatus
methods.description: Determines the current status of a performance review, considering if the API is accessed by the employee itself.

methods.name: checkActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks whether certain actions (like completing or progressing review) are allowed based on user permissions and review state.

methods.name: updateReviewerStatus
methods.description: Sets the reviewer status to 'in progress'.

methods.name: updateReviewStatus
methods.description: Transitions the review status to 'in progress' if currently activated.

methods.name: updateReviewerComment
methods.description: Updates the reviewer's comment on the review.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a review, including ratings and optional comments.

methods.name: isAdminAccessingApi
methods.description: Checks whether the current user has admin-like permissions to access or modify review data via the API.
